sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: What's the story that rocked the sports world?
sentences.zh: 震撼体育界的新闻是什么？

sentences.en: A multi-million dollar betting scheme that led to more than 30 arrests, including current and former NBA players and coaches.
sentences.zh: 一个涉及30多人被捕的数百万美元博彩骗局，其中包括现役和退役的NBA球员及教练。

sentences.en: Today, we go inside the federal investigation into illegal gambling that has rocked the NBA.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将深入报道震动NBA的非法赌博联邦调查。

sentences.en: You know, this is right out of a movie.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这简直就像电影里演的一样。

sentences.en: You're talking about mob stuff.
sentences.zh: 你说的可是黑帮的事。

sentences.en: You're talking about cheating at poker games, rigging poker games.
sentences.zh: 你说的可是扑克牌局作弊、操纵扑克牌局。

sentences.en: The alleged schemes involve the mafia, high-profile players, and the manipulation of professional basketball games to rig and win bets.
sentences.zh: 这些所谓的阴谋涉及黑手党、知名球员，以及操纵职业篮球比赛来做局赢取赌注。

sentences.en: I understand betting is legal, but I don't think it's too much to ask of a player or a coach.
sentences.zh: 我理解赌博是合法的，但我觉得对球员或教练提出这样的要求并不过分。

sentences.en: Do not engage in this.
sentences.zh: 不要参与这种事。

sentences.en: For me, it's all about truSt.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，一切都在于信任。

sentences.en: People watch this game because they think it's real and fair.
sentences.zh: 人们观看这场比赛是因为他们认为它是真实且公平的。

sentences.en: And I'm just ashamed that they put themselves and put their family and put the NBA in this position.
sentences.zh: 我只是为他们让自己、让家人以及让NBA陷入这种境地感到羞耻。

sentences.en: That there's all saying in the hood, all money ain't good money.
sentences.zh: 街区里有句老话，所有的钱可都不是好钱。

sentences.en: I talked to my colleagues, Jonah Bromwich and Jenny Vrentis, about the shocking facts of the cases and the growing concern that the explosion of online betting
sentences.zh: 我和我的同事乔纳·布罗姆维奇和珍妮·弗伦蒂斯聊了聊这些案件令人震惊的事实，以及人们日益增长的担忧：网络赌博的爆发

sentences.en: may be compromising the integrity of the sport.
sentences.zh: 可能会损害这项运动的廉洁性。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 27th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月27日，星期一。

sentences.en: Jonah, the NBA season started last week.
sentences.zh: 乔纳，NBA赛季上周开始了。

sentences.en: Tons of storylines there.
sentences.zh: 有无数的故事线。

sentences.en: Huge week for the league.
sentences.zh: 对联盟来说这是重大的一周。

sentences.en: But the biggest story at this moment for the NBA had nothing to do with the games.
sentences.zh: 但目前对NBA而言最大的新闻却与比赛本身毫无关系。

sentences.en: It was this massive announcement made by the FBI director, Cash Patel, on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 这是联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔周四做出的重大宣布。

sentences.en: So walk me through exactly what he said.
sentences.zh: 所以，请给我详细讲讲他究竟说了什么。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So 6.30 in the morning, we get this email.
sentences.zh: 早上6点30分，我们收到了这封电子邮件。

sentences.en: There's going to be this big announcement.
sentences.zh: 将会有这样一个重大宣布。

sentences.en: And no one really knows what it is beforehand.
sentences.zh: 事先没有人真正知道那是什么。

sentences.en: We're getting kind of bits and pieces of it.
sentences.zh: 我们只得到了零星的一些消息。

sentences.en: But then people go into the room.
sentences.zh: 但随后人们走进了房间。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: And Cash Patel is there.
sentences.zh: 卡什·帕特尔就在那里。

sentences.en: And he starts talking about these two enormously consequential schemes.
sentences.zh: 他开始谈论这两个极其重大的阴谋。

sentences.en: Today, we are here in New York to announce a historic arrest across a wide-sweeping criminal enterprise that envelops both the NBA and La Casa Nostra.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们齐聚纽约，宣布在一场席卷NBA和黑手党（La Cosa Nostra）的庞大犯罪团伙中进行历史性的逮捕。

sentences.en: So the first case is the poker case.
sentences.zh: 所以第一起案件是扑克牌局案。

sentences.en: And that is about a very complicated, mafia-involved scheme to rig poker games.
sentences.zh: 这涉及一个非常复杂的、有黑手党参与的操纵扑克牌局的阴谋。

sentences.en: And prominent NBA figures were used almost as bait to attract the victims to these games.
sentences.zh: 一些知名的NBA人物几乎被当作诱饵，把受害者吸引到这些牌局中。

sentences.en: There is no room for any type of criminal behavior, be it on the world's largest stage or in the back rooms of tiny parlors where guard games are being plugged.
sentences.zh: 任何类型的犯罪行为都没有容身之地，无论是在世界上最大的舞台上，还是在后街小 parlor 里打着卫兵比赛旗号的隐蔽小房间里。

sentences.en: And then the second one intrudes more closely on the life of the league because this is one player, various other co-conspirators, making bets about what's going to happen in games
sentences.zh: 第二起案件则更贴近联盟的生活，因为这是一名球员和各种其他同谋，根据他们在更衣室内部的关系

sentences.en: based on their relationships inside the locker room.
sentences.zh: 对比赛中将要发生的事情进行下注。

sentences.en: It's mind-boggling.
sentences.zh: 这简直令人匪夷所思。

sentences.en: It's not hundreds of dollars.
sentences.zh: 这不是几百美元。

sentences.en: It's not thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 这不是几千美元。

sentences.en: It's not tens of thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 这不是几万美元。

sentences.en: And what is immediately clear in what he's talking about is that the scope of this is enormous.
sentences.zh: 从他所谈论的内容中，立刻可以明显看出，其规模是极其巨大的。

sentences.en: We're talking about tens of millions of dollars in fraud and theft and robbery.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是数千万美元的欺诈、盗窃和抢劫。

sentences.en: And then it hits the league in a place that the league really doesn't want to be hit.
sentences.zh: 然后它击中了联盟最不希望被击中的地方。

sentences.en: And look, let's not, you know, mince words.
sentences.zh: 听着，咱们别拐弯抹角了。

sentences.en: This is the insider trading saga for the NBA.
sentences.zh: 这就是NBA的内幕交易传奇。

sentences.en: Okay, let's take these schemes one by one.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们逐一分析这些阴谋。

sentences.en: And we'll start with the illegal rigged poker games.
sentences.zh: 我们从被操纵的非法扑克局开始。

sentences.en: How did this work?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: Who was there?
sentences.zh: 都有谁在场？

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: I want to know everything.
sentences.zh: 我想知道一切。

sentences.en: So what I'm about to describe, they haven't been proven.
sentences.zh: 我接下来要描述的内容尚未经过证实。

sentences.en: And I'm largely drawing on indictments from prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 我主要依据的是检察官的起诉书。

sentences.en: So defense lawyers have not yet had a say.
sentences.zh: 所以辩护律师还没机会发表意见。

sentences.en: It's not clear what they'll argue.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚他们会辩称什么。

sentences.en: And all of these are just allegations for the moment.
sentences.zh: 目前所有这些都只是指控。

sentences.en: So this is a kind of remarkable story in its own right.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是一个本身就非常了不起的故事。

sentences.en: Because this is a story about pretty high-tech rigging of illegal poker games.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个关于非法扑克局中相当高科技作弊的故事。

sentences.en: They were held regularly at two locations in New York.
sentences.zh: 它们定期在纽约的两个地点举行。

sentences.en: And what would happen is using two NBA figures as bait, the many, many people involved in this scheme would have victims come to these games.
sentences.zh: 具体情况是，利用两个NBA人物作为诱饵，参与此案的众多人员会把受害者引诱到这些牌局中。

sentences.en: And they would use these advanced shuffling machines that could tell them which of them had the best hand
sentences.zh: 他们会使用这些先进的洗牌机，这些机器能告诉他们谁拥有最好的手牌

sentences.en: and coordinate with that knowledge to win this game and defraud victims of their money.
sentences.zh: 并根据这些信息进行配合，从而赢得比赛并诈骗受害者的钱财。

sentences.en: And who's running these poker games?
sentences.zh: 谁在运营这些扑克局？

sentences.en: Like, who's everyone behind all this?
sentences.zh: 比如说，这一切背后的幕后黑手都是谁？

sentences.en: So the mafia is largely behind all this.
sentences.zh: 所以幕后主使基本上是黑手党。

sentences.en: There's four different mafia families.
sentences.zh: 有四个不同的黑手党家族。

sentences.en: There are Bananos, the Gambinos, the Genoveses, and the Luccheses that are involved in poker games.
sentences.zh: 参与扑克局的有博南诺家族、甘比诺家族、热那亚家族和卢切斯家族。

sentences.en: And it does bring up this kind of image of Tony Soprano and the games from that show.
sentences.zh: 这确实让人联想起托尼·索普拉诺以及那部剧里的牌局。

sentences.en: But this is really still happening.
sentences.zh: 但这一切确实仍在发生。

sentences.en: You know, the mafia still exists in New York.
sentences.zh: 你知道，黑手党在纽约依然存在。

sentences.en: And one of the things they do, one of the ways they make money, is by getting these operations off the street, out of the public eye, and at the poker table.
sentences.zh: 他们做的事情之一、赚钱的方式之一，就是把这些违规操作转入地下，避开公众视线，搬到扑克桌上。

sentences.en: Okay, so you have this kind of old-world aspect of this where the mafia is involved.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以你既看到了这种涉及黑手党的旧世界风格的一面。

sentences.en: But it sounds like it was kind of high-tech.
sentences.zh: 但听起来它又相当高科技。

sentences.en: You mentioned these advanced shuffling machines.
sentences.zh: 你提到了这些先进的洗牌机。

sentences.en: Like, the mechanism by which the cheating happens, it was pretty technological.
sentences.zh: 就像作弊的机制一样，相当具有科技含量。

sentences.en: Yeah, and there are a lot of kind of crazy technologies involved in this.
sentences.zh: 是的，这里面涉及很多疯狂的技术。

sentences.en: They're all these kind of almost like James Bond-like gadgets mixed in with this mafia movie that we're hearing about.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像把詹姆斯·邦德式的各种小工具，融入了我们所听说的这部黑手党电影中。

sentences.en: They had decoy cell phones that could detect which cards were on the table at which time.
sentences.zh: 他们有诱饵手机，可以检测出什么时候桌上有哪些牌。

sentences.en: They had playing cards that had these kind of invisible ink markings that you had to wear special contact lenses to see.
sentences.zh: 他们有带有隐形墨水标记的扑克牌，必须戴上特殊的隐形眼镜才能看到。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: And the rig shuffling machines you mentioned, it's funny, they're not rigged in the way that they shuffle.
sentences.zh: 你提到的那些被做过手脚的洗牌机，很有意思，它们洗牌的方式并没有被做手脚。

sentences.en: What they can do is analyze, as they're dealing a hand, the strength of that hand relative to every other hand they've dealt.
sentences.zh: 它们能做的是在发牌时，分析这手牌相对于它们发过的所有其他手牌的强弱。

sentences.en: So the shuffling is above board.
sentences.zh: 所以洗牌过程本身是合规的。

sentences.en: But what happens is that the machine sends a signal to an outside person known as the operator.
sentences.zh: 但发生的情况是，机器向一个被称为操作员的外部人员发送信号。

sentences.en: The operator then sends that information back into the room to the person they call the quarterback or the driver.
sentences.zh: 然后操作员将该信息发回房间，传给他们称之为四分卫或驾驶员的人。

sentences.en: And everyone on the cheating team knows, okay, we're going to coordinate this knowing who has the best hand here.
sentences.zh: 作弊团队中的每个人都知道，好吧，既然我们知道谁手牌最好，我们就要这样来打配合。

sentences.en: Can I ask, how much money were these games raking in?
sentences.zh: 请问，这些牌局捞了多少钱？

sentences.en: I think I'm used to the idea of like a $25 poker night.
sentences.zh: 我想我已经习惯了那种25美元的扑克之夜的概念。

sentences.en: So just lay out for me, what amount is being stolen in this kind of cheating?
sentences.zh: 所以请为我捋一捋，这种作弊手段到底偷走了多少钱？

sentences.en: Like a truly absurd amount, an amount that really kind of makes us curious about who exactly is playing at these games.
sentences.zh: 简直是一个荒谬的数字，一个真正让我们好奇到底是谁在参与这些牌局的数字。

sentences.en: So, for example, John Doe, number one, is named in the indictment.
sentences.zh: 例如，起诉书里提到了约翰·多伊一号（John Doe number one）。

sentences.en: That's the first victim.
sentences.zh: 那是第一个受害者。

sentences.en: John Doe, number one, loses $1.8 million in a single game.
sentences.zh: 约翰·多伊一号在单场比赛中输掉了180万美元。

sentences.en: And so overall, we're talking about millions and millions of dollars at these games, which are held regularly both in the New York locations I mentioned,
sentences.zh: 所以总的来说，我们在这些牌局中谈论的是数百万美元的资金，起诉书称这些牌局不仅在我提到的纽约地点定期举行，

sentences.en: but also all over the United States, the indictment says.
sentences.zh: 而且在全美各地都有举办。

sentences.en: And you said that the NBA players involved, they were used as a draw for the other marks that came.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说，参与其中的NBA球员被用作吸引其他“肥羊”的诱饵。

sentences.en: They made the games cool.
sentences.zh: 他们让这些牌局显得很酷。

sentences.en: So the implication is that they were getting a cut of the winnings?
sentences.zh: 所以暗示的意思是他们能分到一部分赢来的钱？

sentences.en: Like, were they in business with the mafia?
sentences.zh: 他们是不是和黑手党有商业合作？

sentences.en: They're directly accused of getting a cut of the winnings.
sentences.zh: 他们被直接指控分得了赢来的钱。

sentences.en: So yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: They are accused of doing business with the mafia, one of whom is quite well known to NBA fans,
sentences.zh: 他们被指控与黑手党做生意，其中一人对NBA球迷来说非常熟悉，

sentences.en: Chauncey Billups, NBA champion, current head coach for the Portland Trailblazers.
sentences.zh: 那就是昌西·比卢普斯，NBA总冠军，波特兰开拓者队现任主教练。

sentences.en: And the collection of guys at this table is really fascinating, right?
sentences.zh: 坐在这张桌子旁的一群人真的很有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: Because it's mafia members.
sentences.zh: 因为这里面有黑手党成员。

sentences.en: And then it's these almost sports betting nerds who love poker.
sentences.zh: 然后还有这些酷爱扑克的体育博彩书呆子。

sentences.en: So just imagine that game.
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下那场比赛。

sentences.en: Imagine the personalities that half the side is cheating.
sentences.zh: 想象一下这些个性，其中一半人还在作弊。

sentences.en: It's just an extraordinary scene to think about.
sentences.zh: 光是想想这都是个极其不寻常的场面。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to turn to the other indictment.
sentences.zh: 我想转向另一份起诉书。

sentences.en: Cash Patel called this one insider trading for the NBA.
sentences.zh: 卡什·帕特尔将这个案子称为NBA的内幕交易。

sentences.en: Is that accurate?
sentences.zh: 这准确吗？

sentences.en: What are we talking about here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里到底在谈论什么？

sentences.en: So this is a scheme where, according to the indictment, an NBA player and co-conspirators traded on information known only to them,
sentences.zh: 这是一个根据起诉书所述的阴谋：一名NBA球员和同谋利用只有他们自己知道的信息进行交易，

sentences.en: known only to people who would be inside the locker room.
sentences.zh: 这些信息只有更衣室内部的人才知道。

sentences.en: And they used it to gamble on games with an advantage that no one else had.
sentences.zh: 他们利用这些信息在比赛中下注，从而获得了其他人所没有的优势。

sentences.en: And that's exactly how insider trading works.
sentences.zh: 这正是内幕交易的运作方式。

sentences.en: You have information that is not available to the public, and you use that information to your financial advantage.
sentences.zh: 你掌握了公众无法获得的信息，并利用这些信息为自己谋取财务优势。

sentences.en: So it's actually a perfect explanation of what happened here.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上是对这里发生的事情的完美解释。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit more about how they used it to their advantage.
sentences.zh: 再多告诉我一点他们是如何利用这一点为自己谋利的。

sentences.en: Like, specifically in this case, what were they doing?
sentences.zh: 具体在这个案件中，他们到底在做什么？

sentences.en: How did they make money?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么赚钱的？

sentences.en: So there are a couple different ways that they used the information that they had access to.
sentences.zh: 他们利用所掌握的信息有几种不同的方式。

sentences.en: And the first example is the most outrageous, and I think maybe the most troubling for the NBA.
sentences.zh: 第一个例子是最离谱的，我认为对NBA来说也许是最令人不安的。

sentences.en: So the one active NBA player who is a defendant here is a guy named Terry Rozier.
sentences.zh: 这里被告中唯一现役的NBA球员是一个叫特里·罗齐尔的人。

sentences.en: Terry Rozier, he's currently a guard in the Miami Heat.
sentences.zh: 特里·罗齐尔，他目前是迈阿密热火队的后卫。

sentences.en: But in 2023, he was a player for the Charlotte Hornets.
sentences.zh: 但在2023年，他是夏洛特黄蜂队的一名球员。

sentences.en: And while playing for the Hornets, told his co-conspirators, hey, I'm going to go out of this game early with an injury.
sentences.zh: 在黄蜂队效力期间，他告诉他的同谋，嘿，我要因伤提前退出这场比赛。

sentences.en: And no one knows that I'm going to do that, including officials on my own team.
sentences.zh: 除了我没人知道我要这么做，包括我球队里的官方人员。

sentences.en: So knowing that Rozier was going to go out of this game early was an enormous advantage.
sentences.zh: 所以，提前知道罗齐尔会退出这场比赛是一个巨大的优势。

sentences.en: And it was an advantage because his co-conspirators then bet that he would score fewer points, that he would be less productive in this game than he usually was.
sentences.zh: 这是一个优势，因为他的同谋随后下注赌他会得更少的分，在这场比赛中的表现会比平时更差。

sentences.en: And of course, they were right, because when he went out early, there was no chance that he was going to make up those averages,
sentences.zh: 当然，他们是对的，因为当他提前离场时，他根本不可能把这些平均数据追回来了，

sentences.en: and they were able to win hundreds of thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们因此能够赢得几十万美元。

sentences.en: So what you're talking about, those bets on how many points he's going to score at a certain point in the game, those are what's been referred to as prop bets.
sentences.zh: 所以你们所说的那些关于他在比赛中某个时刻能得多少分的下注，就是所谓的玩家专属道具赌注（prop bets）。

sentences.en: Can you just break down what prop bets are?
sentences.zh: 你能简单解释一下什么是道具赌注吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: So I think when people who do not gamble on sports consider sports betting, when they consider it at all,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，当那些平时不参与体育博彩的人看待体育博彩时，如果他们真的关注的话，

sentences.en: they might think that the easiest way to do it is you're going to bet on who wins and who loses.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会觉得最简单的做法就是押注谁赢谁输。

sentences.en: But sports gambling has gotten a lot more sophisticated, and you can bet on all these different kinds of elements of a game, including an individual player's performance,
sentences.zh: 但体育博彩已经变得复杂得多，你可以对比赛中的各种不同元素进行下注，包括单个球员的表现，

sentences.en: an individual player's performance in a certain category, like points scored, rebounds.
sentences.zh: 单个球员在特定数据类别中的表现，比如得分、篮板。

sentences.en: The amount of betting categories has become really vaSt.
sentences.zh: 博彩类别的数量已经变得非常庞大。

sentences.en: And that's important here because it shows you that just Terry Rozier, one person on a team of at least 11 basketball players, can actively impact betting,
sentences.zh: 这在这里很重要，因为它向你表明，仅仅是特里·罗齐尔（Terry Rozier）——一支至少有11名篮球运动员的球队中的一个人——就能对博彩产生实际影响，

sentences.en: even if he can't ultimately control the outcome of a game.
sentences.zh: 尽管他最终可能无法控制比赛的结果。

sentences.en: And that's what's at issue here, not just with Rozier, right?
sentences.zh: 这正是本案的关键所在，不仅仅是罗齐尔，对吧？

sentences.en: The idea is that the information that was being traded was used to manipulate bets on individual events like this.
sentences.zh: 其核心在于，被交易的信息被用来操纵诸如此类的个人事件的赌局。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: And I'll give you another example.
sentences.zh: 我再给你举个例子。

sentences.en: And this one is eyebrow raising, not because it involves the kind of obvious flagrant violation that Rozier is accused of, but because of the name it does involve.
sentences.zh: 这个例子令人咋舌，不是因为它涉及罗齐尔被指控的那种显而易见的严重违规，而是因为其中涉及的名字。

sentences.en: So the other NBA figure involved in this scheme is a guy named Damon Jones.
sentences.zh: 卷入这个阴谋的另一位NBA人物是一个名叫达蒙·琼斯（Damon Jones）的家伙。

sentences.en: And in February 2023, he was an unofficial assistant coach for the Los Angeles Lakers.
sentences.zh: 2023年2月，他是洛杉矶湖人队的非官方助理教练。

sentences.en: While he was in that role, he got information that a prominent player, according to the indictment, named Player Three, was not going to play in a game.
sentences.zh: 正是在扮演这个角色期间，他获得了根据起诉书显示的一名知名球员（被称为“三号球员”）将不参加一场比赛的信息。

sentences.en: Jones then quickly spread that information to his co-conspirators.
sentences.zh: 琼斯随后迅速将这一信息传播给他的同谋。

sentences.en: They just bet on the Lakers losing that game.
sentences.zh: 他们随即押注湖人队输掉那场比赛。

sentences.en: And the description of Player Three in the indictment perfectly matches LeBron James.
sentences.zh: 起诉书对“三号球员”的描述与勒布朗·詹姆斯完全吻合。

sentences.en: Now, LeBron is not accused of any wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 不过，勒布朗并没有被指控有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: He's not even implicated.
sentences.zh: 他甚至都没有被牵连进去。

sentences.en: But you can see why this is such a huge problem for the NBA.
sentences.zh: 但你可以看出，为什么这对NBA来说是个如此巨大的问题。

sentences.en: Because even the specter of the possibility that a scheme like this touched on their most marketable star, the face of their sport for more than a decade,
sentences.zh: 因为哪怕有一点点可能性，让人觉得这样的阴谋触及了他们最具商业价值的明星、十多年来这项运动的门面，

sentences.en: hints at the issues when the integrity of an NBA game begins to be called into question.
sentences.zh: 都在暗示当NBA比赛的公正性开始受到质疑时所出现的问题。

sentences.en: Jonah, you've covered really big cases for us, including Trump trials, the Letitia James arraignment.
sentences.zh: 乔纳，你为我们报道过非常重大的案件，包括特朗普案、莉蒂亚·詹姆斯（Letitia James）提审案。

sentences.en: Where does this rank for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说处于什么位置？

sentences.en: In the pantheon of all of the cases you've been looking at, how earth-shattering does it feel?
sentences.zh: 在你经手过的所有案件中，它听起来有多么震撼？

sentences.en: Yeah, in terms of the scale and high-profile nature of what I often cover, it doesn't quite touch those things.
sentences.zh: 是的，就我经常报道的案件的规模和备受瞩目的程度而言，它还比不上那些大案。

sentences.en: But criminal cases always in some way touch on what's going on in society.
sentences.zh: 但刑事案件总归在某种程度上触及了社会正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Like, that seems like a silly thing to say, but it's actually what makes it so interesting.
sentences.zh: 听起来这好像是一句废话，但恰恰是这一点让它如此引人入胜。

sentences.en: There's all this legality.
sentences.zh: 这里有各种各样的法律问题。

sentences.en: There's all these specifics of these indictments.
sentences.zh: 有这些起诉书的各种具体细节。

sentences.en: But it always touches back with something that's going on in the broader world.
sentences.zh: 但它总是能回归到更广泛世界中正在发生的事情上去。

sentences.en: And I just see that this case, like the other cases that I've covered, really speaks to something that's going on in the moment.
sentences.zh: 我发现这个案子就像我报道过的其他案件一样，确实反映了当下正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: In this case, exactly what's going on in sports gambling and why it poses such a problem for these leagues in 2025.
sentences.zh: 就本案而言，恰恰反映了体育博彩领域正在发生的事情，以及为什么它在2025年给这些联盟带来如此巨大的难题。

sentences.en: Well, Jonah, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔纳，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Of course, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 当然，谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: After the break, I'll talk to my colleague Jenny Vrentis about exactly that.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将和我的同事珍妮·弗伦蒂斯（Jenny Vrentis）专门讨论这个话题。

sentences.en: How the proliferation of sports betting may contribute to scandals like this and the impact that it's had on our culture.
sentences.zh: 体育博彩的激增是如何助长此类丑闻的，以及它对我们文化产生的影响。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·洛（Wena Lowe）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块的纵横连线（Connections）谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基（Sam Mazursky），我每天负责创作“拼字比赛”（Spelling Bee）和“字母方框”（Letterboxd）游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚刚听到的这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始游玩吧。

sentences.en: Jenny, we are here to talk to you about the sports betting indictment.
sentences.zh: 珍妮，我们今天在这里要和你聊聊关于体育博彩的起诉书。

sentences.en: That just seems like it has really huge implications, definitely for the NBA and maybe for sports in general.
sentences.zh: 这似乎有着非常巨大的影响，对NBA绝对如此，对整个体育界可能也是如此。

sentences.en: And in many ways, it does seem as though sports betting has proliferated in recent years, especially these prop bets that are central to this indictment.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，近年来体育博彩似乎确实呈几何级数增长，特别是作为本案核心的这些道具赌注。

sentences.en: And this is a question that I think a lot of people have been asking.
sentences.zh: 这也是我认为许多人一直在追问的问题。

sentences.en: What effect will it have on the integrity of the game?
sentences.zh: 它会对比赛的公正性产生什么影响？

sentences.en: You've been covering this world for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 你报道这个领域已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: So let me just ask you, do you think that the explosion of online sports betting enabled the criminal conspiracy that was just revealed?
sentences.zh: 所以我想问你，你认为在线体育博彩的爆发是否促成了刚刚被揭露的犯罪阴谋？

sentences.en: I think it creates conditions in which gambling is more normalized, more part of society, and there are more chances for criminal activity.
sentences.zh: 我认为它创造了一种环境，在这种环境中，赌博变得更加常态化、更加融入社会，从而也产生了更多进行犯罪活动的机遇。

sentences.en: Obviously, these crimes are still in the stage where the people have been accused and the crimes haven't been adjudicated.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这些罪行目前仍处于嫌疑人被起诉、案件尚未审判的阶段。

sentences.en: But I do think what we're seeing now with this situation is this is what sports leagues didn't want to happen.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，我们现在从这种局势中看到的是，这正是体育联盟最不愿发生的事情。

sentences.en: This is what fans didn't want to happen.
sentences.zh: 这也是球迷们最不愿看到的事情。

sentences.en: And now that it's happened, okay, it's one case, but it involves a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 既然事情已经发生了，好吧，这虽然只是一起案件，但它涉及大量人员。

sentences.en: It involves multiple players, coaches, sharing information on multiple teams, on multiple games.
sentences.zh: 它涉及多支球队、多场比赛中的多名球员和教练共享信息。

sentences.en: And so I do think it's fair for fans and anyone who loves sports in the United States to wonder, is this just the tip of the iceberg?
sentences.zh: 因此我认为，球迷和任何热爱美国体育的人都会感到好奇，这会不会仅仅是冰山一角？

sentences.en: Okay, I want to get to the question that you raise about whether this is possibly way more widespread than we even know.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想探讨一下你提出的那个问题，即这是否可能比我们所知的要广泛得多。

sentences.en: But just to slow down and pause for a moment, can we walk through exactly what this embrace of sports betting has looked like from the perspective of the leagues, fans,
sentences.zh: 不过先放慢节奏暂停一下，我们能否从联盟、球迷以及球员自身的角度，来仔细梳理一下各方对体育博彩的这种拥抱究竟是怎样的？

sentences.en: and the players themselves?
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 就在不久前，体育联盟还反对在美国将体育博彩合法化。

sentences.en: It wasn't that long ago that sports leagues were opposed to the legalization of sports betting in the United States.
sentences.zh: 然而在2018年，最高法院推翻了一项实际上在全美大部分地区禁止体育博彩的法律。

sentences.en: However, in 2018, the Supreme Court overturned a law that effectively banned sports betting in most of the country.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的是巨大的商业机遇，体育联盟都想利用这些机遇。

sentences.en: And as a consequence, there were significant business opportunities that came from that, that sports leagues wanted to take advantage of.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们与博彩公司建立了合作伙伴关系。

sentences.en: So they built partnerships with sports books.
sentences.zh: 你想让每场比赛都变得有趣吗？

sentences.en: You want to make every game interesting?
sentences.zh: 第一步，打开BetMGM体育博彩公司。

sentences.en: Step one, open the BetMGM sports book.
sentences.zh: 第二步，参与其中，押上真金白银。

sentences.en: Step two, put some skin in the game.
sentences.zh: 第三步，精彩开场。

sentences.en: And step three, showtime.
sentences.zh: 这里有授权协议。

sentences.en: There are licensing deals.
sentences.zh: 新球馆。

sentences.en: New arena.
sentences.zh: 来个新网络怎么样？

sentences.en: How about a new network?
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到 FanDuel 体育频道。

sentences.en: Welcome to FanDuel Sports Network.
sentences.zh: 快船队篮球的主场。

sentences.en: Your home for Clippers basketball.
sentences.zh: 体育场到处都是标牌。

sentences.en: There is signage all over stadiuMs.
sentences.zh: 一些体育场内部甚至设有博彩公司。

sentences.en: Some stadiums have sports books inside of them.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以在比赛进行时进行下注。

sentences.en: You can even bet on games while they're still being played.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Seriously.
sentences.zh: 在电视转播期间，会有提示鼓励在比赛中下注。

sentences.en: During TV broadcasts, there are prompts to bet during the game.
sentences.zh: 现在你正与体育博彩之王同台竞技。

sentences.en: Now you're in the ring with the king of sports books.
sentences.zh: 你知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: You know what to do.
sentences.zh: 在过去七年里，这种变化的速度令人头晕目眩。

sentences.en: How quickly this has changed in the last seven years is dizzying.
sentences.zh: 我是一个长期关注体育、报道体育的人。

sentences.en: I'm a person that has followed sports, covered sports for a long time.
sentences.zh: 即便是我，也对博彩融入我们消费体育的方式的速度之快感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And even I am surprised by how quickly betting has become embedded into how we consume sports.
sentences.zh: 是的，此时此刻我大概也应该亮明自己作为一个狂热体育迷的身份了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I should probably at this point come out as a huge sports fan myself.
sentences.zh: 我也同样对所有这些广告铺天盖地的程度感到震惊，无论是在中场休息时还是在比赛中，它们都无处不在。

sentences.en: I've also been shocked at just how much all of this is plastered everywhere, how unavoidable it is at halftime, at the games.
sentences.zh: 无处不在。

sentences.en: It's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想我以前有一点不太明白，那就是这些规模较小的道具赌注，以及它们对这个新基础设施、这个新行业有多么重要。

sentences.en: I think one of the things I didn't understand, though, was these smaller prop bets and how important they are to this new infrastructure, to this new industry.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对如此。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，赌博的体量和类型呈指数级爆发。

sentences.en: The volume and types of bets has exploded exponentially over the last few years.
sentences.zh: 我认为其结果就是，你为比赛中个人事件可能被操纵提供了更多的机会。

sentences.en: And I think as a consequence of that, you are presenting more opportunities for individual occurrences in the game to potentially be manipulated.
sentences.zh: 因为想要操纵整场比赛是非常困难的。

sentences.en: Because it's very hard to fix a game.
sentences.zh: 你需要全队的配合。

sentences.en: You need cooperation of the entire team.
sentences.zh: 你无法控制比赛中发生的一切。

sentences.en: You can't control everything that happens in a game.
sentences.zh: 但你能做到的是，在某种程度上控制你个人的表现、或某个单独时段的结果、或你比赛中的某一个部分。

sentences.en: But what you can do is you can control, in some level, your individual performance or the outcome of a single period of time or a single part of your game.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你是一名投手，显然你可以控制你投出的球的类型。

sentences.en: Like, if you're a pitcher, obviously you can control the kind of pitch you throw.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名控球后卫，你可以在任何时候决定把球传给谁。

sentences.en: If you're a point guard, you can decide who gets the ball at any point.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否能带我了解一下其中的参与度方面。

sentences.en: I'm wondering if you can walk me through the engagement aspect of this.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果人们对每一个单独的结果进行下注，这会对球迷体验和整体观看体验产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Like, what does it do to a fan experience and to the overall watching experience if people are betting on each of these individual outcomes?
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是这场讨论中非常重要的一部分，因为这也是联盟拥抱体育博彩的部分原因。

sentences.en: And I think that's a huge piece of this conversation because this is part of the reason that leagues have embraced sports betting.
sentences.zh: 因为他们相信，如果人们在赛前和赛中下注，他们就会观看更多比赛、持续更长时间。

sentences.en: Because they believe that if people are betting on games and during games, that they will watch more games for longer periods of time.
sentences.zh: 我们还看到，这种在比赛期间进行的下注有所增加，某种程度上让人们持续观赛并对比赛保持兴趣。

sentences.en: And we've also seen this increase in these bets that come during a game, sort of keep people watching and keep people interested in a game.
sentences.zh: 否则，你可能对观看比赛毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: Maybe you would have no interest in watching otherwise.
sentences.zh: 这一切都助长了球迷的参与度。

sentences.en: And that all feeds into fan engagement.
sentences.zh: 关注比赛的目光越多，媒体版权交易的价格——也就是NBA和NFL最大利润来源——就会水涨船高。

sentences.en: The more eyes that are on games, then the price of the media rights deals, which are the largest source of profit for the NBA and the NFL, that goes up.
sentences.zh: 因此你就能明白，为什么在整场比赛中会有这种推动更多博彩机会的动力了。

sentences.en: And so there you see why there has been this push of more betting opportunities throughout games.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈联盟在这里的经济利益。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the league's economic interests here.
sentences.zh: 拥抱体育博彩给他们的净利润带来了什么？

sentences.en: What has embracing sports betting done for their bottom line?
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，体育博彩一直是体育联盟巨大的财务福音。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, sports betting has been a huge financial boon for sports leagues.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们与体育博彩运营商的合作伙伴关系每年能带来数亿美元的净收入。

sentences.en: I mean, they have partnerships with sports betting operators that net something around hundreds of millions of dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 他们持有这些数据公司的股份，这些公司将体育比赛的统计数据出售给博彩公司，例如，这些数据被用来创建其中一些道具赌注。

sentences.en: They have stakes in these data companies that sell statistics from sports games to sports books, which are used to create some of these prop bets, for instance.
sentences.zh: 因此，它已经演变成这样一个生态系统：体育博彩深深嵌入到了联盟的商业利益中，以至于现在很难再退出了。

sentences.en: And so it's become this ecosystem where sports betting is so embedded in the business interests of the leagues that it would be hard to back out at this point.
sentences.zh: 他们已经彻底纠缠在一起了。

sentences.en: They're just totally enmeshed.
sentences.zh: 他们彻底纠缠在一起了。

sentences.en: They're totally enmeshed.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 回到本起诉书中所列出的阴谋上来，我可以想象这样一种情况：人们可能会看着发生的事情说，看吧，

sentences.en: To just return to the conspiracy that has been laid out in this indictment, I can see a world in which people might look at what's happened and say, look, actually,
sentences.zh: 在线体育博彩的兴起，使你能够更容易地追踪异常的赌局。

sentences.en: the rise of online sports betting, it allows you to track more easily unusual bets.
sentences.zh: 因此，并不是在线体育博彩的兴起促成了这一切。

sentences.en: And therefore, it's not the rise of online sports betting that enabled this.
sentences.zh: 这只是一般的赌博罢了。

sentences.en: This is just gambling.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，我们现在处于能够更容易地抓获这种行为的境地。

sentences.en: And actually, we're in a position where we can catch this more easily.
sentences.zh: 但从另一方面来看，根据你的说法，对每一个微小的事情进行下注确实变得容易得多了。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, it does seem as though, from what you're saying, it's just become so much easier to bet on every little tiny thing.
sentences.zh: 比如，很难想象在过去能找到一个愿意接受“某人在第三节最后两分钟内是否能投进三分球”下注的庄家。

sentences.en: Like, it's hard to imagine finding a bookie back in the day who's willing to take a bet on whether someone is going to hit a three in the last two minutes of the third quarter.
sentences.zh: 因此，从某种意义上说，这种激增本身确实为这样的丑闻铺平了道路。

sentences.en: And so there's a world in which the proliferation itself does pave the way for a scandal like this.
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: Yeah,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种“两种情况都属实”的局面，一方面，博彩公司和体育联盟确实与专门抓取可疑博彩活动的诚信监测机构合作，正是这些监测机构在发现这起丑闻中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: I think it's sort of a both things are true situation here and that it is true that sports books and sports leagues work with integrity monitors that are catching suspicious betting activity and that those integrity monitors played a role in spotting this scandal.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得你提出的观点——我认为也是正确的——是，当你身处这样一个世界，可以通过一场比赛的过程对如此之多的事物进行下注时，

sentences.en: But I think the point that you're making, which I think is a true one, is that when you have this world in which you can bet on so many things through the course of a game,
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑到这样一个事实：操纵的机会增多了。

sentences.en: you have to consider the fact that there are more chances for manipulation.
sentences.zh: 当存在如此之多的机会时，要抓获作弊行为也变得更加困难。

sentences.en: And it makes it harder to catch when there are so many more opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈NBA目前的选择，因为其中的利益驱动相当有趣。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the options for the NBA right now, because the incentives are kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你可以看出如果人们开始大规模怀疑他们在球场上看到的是假的时，他们会多么担忧。

sentences.en: On the one hand, you can see how they'd be worried if people start to en masse doubt that what they're seeing on the court is real.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，正如你所说，这对他们来说是一项巨大的生意。

sentences.en: On the other hand, as you've said, this is just a huge business for them.
sentences.zh: 我认为有趣的是，比赛的公正性实际上是所有利益相关者都关心的事。

sentences.en: I think the interesting thing is that game integrity is actually something that all of the stakeholders care about.
sentences.zh: 博彩公司关心它，联盟关心它，赌博者也关心它。

sentences.en: The sports books care about it, the leagues care about it, the bettors care about it.
sentences.zh: 如果球迷开始相信博彩会影响场上球员或球队教练去操纵比赛，

sentences.en: If fans start to believe that betting is an influence for players on the court or coaches of teams to start manipulating games,
sentences.zh: 那确实会削弱球迷在观看比赛时的信任感和体验。

sentences.en: it really does undercut the trust and the experience that fans have when they watch.
sentences.zh: 当球迷开始怀疑下注在其中起了负面作用时，体验就彻底被破坏了。

sentences.en: What I do think is a potential landing spot here is for sports leagues to come together and say, we are going to limit or ban prop bets.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里一个潜在的落脚点是体育联盟联合起来宣布，我们要限制或禁止球员表现盘口。

sentences.en: However, on the sports book side, prop bets are a big part of their business.
sentences.zh: 然而，对博彩公司而言，表现盘口是他们业务的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: I mean, one estimate that I received would be if you limited prop bets, you would potentially be reducing the amount that people bet by around 20%.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我收到的一个估计是，如果你限制表现盘口，你可能会让人们的投注总额减少大约20%。

sentences.en: That's significant for sports books and their business.
sentences.zh: 这对博彩公司和他们的业务来说非常重大。

sentences.en: And so this could be an area where you see what is now a shared business interest colliding a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会成为一个领域，你会看到原本共享的商业利益发生一些碰撞。

sentences.en: Okay, so we've talked about the implications for the league, for the fans.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们已经讨论了这对联盟和球迷的影响。

sentences.en: I want to ask about the players, because watching this all unfold, it made me think that, you know, they're at risk from this, too.
sentences.zh: 我想问问关于球员的事，因为看着这一切的发展，这让我觉得，你知道，他们也面临着风险。

sentences.en: It raises the possibility that suddenly the players will be under more suspicion, right, that especially if they aren't doing well,
sentences.zh: 这就引出了一种可能性，即球员突然会受到更多怀疑，对吧，尤其是当他们表现不佳时，

sentences.en: if they're injured or even if they just miss a couple shots, that people might think they're setting up a bet.
sentences.zh: 如果他们受伤了，甚至只是投丢了几个球，人们可能会觉得他们在操纵赌局。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's a really great question, and I'm glad you raised it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得这是一个非常好的问题，我很高兴你提出了这一点。

sentences.en: We've seen that players, you know, they'll get harassing messages from angry bettors who a bet didn't go their way.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到球员们，你知道的，他们会收到来自愤怒赌徒的骚扰信息，因为赌局没有按照他们的预期发展。

sentences.en: A lot of players have started to speak out about this.
sentences.zh: 许多球员已经开始公开谈论这件事。

sentences.en: I think there's another element here, too, which is the pressure from people around you to get inside information from you.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里还有另一个因素，那就是来自你身边的人的压力，要求从你那里获取内幕消息。

sentences.en: And what we saw in the federal indictments is there were several cases in which people in somebody's entourage or a childhood friend or a trainer was sharing information about the players.
sentences.zh: 我们在联邦起诉书中看到的是，有几个案件中，某人随从团队中的成员、儿时好友或训练师在分享关于球员的信息。

sentences.en: And I think where you could see the pressure being the hardest to navigate is for people who aren't paid millions of dollars, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，对于那些没有拿到数百万美元报酬的人来说，这种压力可能最难应付，你知道的，

sentences.en: for college athletes or people in lower tier pro leagues who might be getting pressure from people for inside information and maybe the money feels worth it to them.
sentences.zh: 对于大学运动员或低级别职业联赛的人来说，他们可能会面临他人索要内幕消息的压力，而且对他们来说，这些钱可能显得很值得。

sentences.en: So I do think there are a lot of consequences for the players dealing with how much sports gambling has become part of the sports world that they're in.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实认为，随着体育博彩如此深入地融入他们所处的体育世界，球员们要应对这带来的很多后果。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, they haven't had any input into that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道的，他们对此没有任何发言权。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the world that they're playing in, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是他们正在其中打球的世界，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This has been totally foisted on them, and they have to deal with the consequences, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来这一切完全是强加给他们的，而他们不得不承担相应的后果。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You mentioned this earlier, and I want to just come back to it.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了这一点，我想再谈谈。

sentences.en: But how worried are fans, are experts, are you, that this could be more widespread than just this one scandal?
sentences.zh: 但是球迷、专家以及你本人，有多担心这可能不仅限于这起丑闻，还会更加广泛？

sentences.en: You know, that this could be in many different sports.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这可能会蔓延到许多不同的运动中。

sentences.en: There's a world in which it sort of seems like you kind of have to be worried about that,
sentences.zh: 在某种情况下，似乎你不得不为此感到担忧，

sentences.en: wondering whether anything you're watching in any one of these leagues could be manipulated at any moment.
sentences.zh: 琢磨着你在这些联盟中观看的任何一场比赛，是否会在任何时刻被人操纵。

sentences.en: I think it's fair for any of us to ponder that.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们任何人思考这个问题都是合情合理的。

sentences.en: And I think once you start to ponder that, then the cracks begin.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为一旦你开始思考这个问题，裂痕就开始出现了。

sentences.en: Even in just this federal indictment, right, there were multiple teams, multiple games, multiple years, players, coaches.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是在这份联邦起诉书中，对吧，就涉及多支球队、多场比赛、多年时间、球员和教练。

sentences.en: There were a lot of parts of the NBA affected by this.
sentences.zh: NBA有很多部分都受到了这起事件的影响。

sentences.en: And I think it's come up enough times that it is a persistent concern that the leagues are going to have to confront.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这个问题已经被提及了足够多的次数，成了一个联盟不得不直面的持续担忧。

sentences.en: And American sports fans are going to have to reckon with more and more.
sentences.zh: 美国体育迷也将不得不越来越多地正视这一点。

sentences.en: Well, Jenny, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，珍妮，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.zh: 自从起诉书公布以来，众议院能源和商业委员会已经要求NBA总裁亚当·萧华在本周五（即10月31日）之前，就这起丑闻作出一份简报。

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
